Shipping & Returns Policy

This Shipping & Returns Policy explains how Merso B.V. ("we", "our", "us") processes and delivers orders and how customers can return or exchange products purchased from our online store. By placing an order, you agree to the terms set out below.

Shipping Rates

We ship to the Netherlands, across the EU, and to selected international destinations. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout based on your order:

  • 1 knit: flat rate of €5.95 within the EU
  • 2 or more knits: free shipping within the EU

Shipping costs for destinations outside the EU are displayed at checkout and may vary depending on the delivery address and items ordered.

Dispatch & Delivery Times

We aim to dispatch all in-stock items within 1–2 business days of receiving payment. Estimated delivery times are provided as a guide and are not guaranteed, as they may be affected by factors beyond our control such as customs delays, weather conditions, or carrier disruptions. You will receive a confirmation email with tracking details once your order has been shipped.

We ship via DHL Parcel. Estimated delivery times by country:

1 business day

  • Netherlands (Mon–Sat)

3 business days (Economy) / 2 business days (Worldwide)

  • Germany, Belgium, France, Italy, Austria, Denmark, Sweden, Poland, Czech Republic, Hungary, Luxembourg, Slovenia, Croatia, Norway, Switzerland, Liechtenstein

4 business days (Economy) / 2 business days (Worldwide)

  • Spain, Finland, Ireland, Romania, Bulgaria, Slovakia, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania

4 business days (Economy) / 3 business days (Worldwide)

  • Portugal

7 business days (Economy) / 2 business days (Worldwide)

  • Greece, Serbia

Risk & Delivery Responsibility

Risk in the goods passes to you upon delivery to the shipping address you provided. Please ensure your details are accurate at the time of ordering, as we cannot be held responsible for delays or losses caused by incorrect or incomplete delivery information. If a parcel cannot be delivered and is returned to us, we may charge additional shipping costs for redelivery.

Returns

You have the right to return your order within 30 days of receiving it, in accordance with EU consumer protection laws. To be eligible for a return, items must be unused, unwashed, in their original condition, and with all labels and packaging intact. We recommend using a tracked shipping method for returns, as we are not responsible for items lost in transit. Unless the item is faulty or incorrect, return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer.

To initiate a return, please contact us at operations@merso.com with your order number and details of the item you wish to return. We will provide instructions on how to send the item back.

Refunds

Once we receive and inspect the returned item, we will process your refund within 14 days using the same payment method you used for the original purchase. Original shipping costs are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.

Faulty or Incorrect Items

If you receive an item that is defective, damaged, or not what you ordered, please contact us immediately so we can arrange a replacement or full refund at no cost to you. In such cases, we will cover the return shipping costs.

Policy Updates

We reserve the right to update this Shipping & Returns Policy from time to time. The latest version will always be available on our website. For any questions, contact us at: Merso B.V. – operations@merso.com

Why Merino 

100% Ultra-Fine Merino

Nature’s finest performance fiber. Upgraded.

Merino wool is breathable, thermoregulating, odor-resistant, and incredibly soft, nature’s own high-performance material.

Unlike synthetics, it stays fresh and adapts to your body. Unlike cotton, it insulates even when wet and dries fast. Unlike traditional wool, it’s itch-free, lightweight, and wearable all year.

At Merso®️, we take pure merino and give it an edge:

  • Machine-washable: thanks to advanced treatments.
  • Structured fit:  engineered through precision knitting.
  • Lasting comfort:  spun to resist pilling and retain shape.
  • Unlimited colors:  curated tones with rich, wearable depth.

100% merino. Pure performance. For Everyday Adventures

settings.title: How to wash
settings.content:
• Machine wash temperature (30°C / 85°F)
  • Use a gentle cycle
  • Mild detergent only
  • Turn garments inside out
  • Wash with like colors

settings.title: How to Dry
settings.content:
• Lay flat to dry
  • Do not tumble dry
  • Do not wring or twist
  • Never hang wet, it can stretch the fibers

settings.title: How to Store
settings.content:
• Fold, don’t hang, to preserve the shape
  • Keep in a dry, cool place
  • Optional: use cedar or lavender to naturally deter moths

settings.title: Pro Tip
settings.subheading: Care less. Wear more. That’s the Merso way.
settings.content: Merino stays fresh for longer. Air it out between wears to reduce washing and extend its life.
